data.name: Himansu
data.gender_notes: Himansu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has a pure soul and a sharp intellect. The name Himansu carries the meaning “Soul, Mind, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Himansu usually hope their child will grow to embody soul, mind, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pure soul with a sharp intellect, ready to serve and protect
data.etymology: Himansu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soul, Mind, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Himansu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Himansu" is rooted in Hindu culture, derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a rare, beautiful, and poetic name which signifies having a pure soul and a sharp intellect. It is a prestigious name, especially in traditional and orthodox Indian families. A person named Himansu is perceived as wise, pure, intelligent, and man of virtue.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Himansu holds significant spiritual significance for Hindus as it signifies having a pure soul and a sharp intellect. These two qualities are highly valued in Hinduism as they help an individual to attain Self-Realization and moksha (liberation). Moreover, the sharp intellect is required to understand and follow the Dharma (righteous path) set by the Hindu scriptures and traditions. The name Himansu, therefore, acts as a constant reminder for the individual to strive for purity of the soul and sharpness of the intellect throughout their life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Himansu: Radiating purity and brilliance like the sun, one who is saturated with divine consciousness.

historical_references.reference: Himansu was a legendary king of Haihayas, mentioned in Mahabharata. He ruled the kingdom of Mathura in North India, around 5000 BC.
historical_references.context: Mahabharata, Hindu mythology, legendary king of Haihayas, ruler of Mathura

historical_references.reference: Himansu Shashtri was a well-known Hindu philosopher, logician, and writer, who lived during 13th-14th century AD. He is known for his commentaries on various Hindu scriptures.
historical_references.context: Hindu philosophy, Hindu logic, Hindu scriptures, commentaries, Himansu Shashtri

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Himansu' in its modern context often represents an individual who is deeply spiritual and practices yoga and mindfulness to maintain a balanced and peaceful mind. In the digital age, Himansu can be found sharing their journey on various platforms such as Instagram, where they post inspiring quotes and stunning photography showcasing their yoga practices. On YouTube, they might have a channel where they share guided meditations, yoga tutorials, and personal stories to help others on their own spiritual journeys. Lastly, on Medium, they might write articles or essays about their experiences with spirituality, yoga, and mindfulness, providing insight and guidance for those seeking a deeper understanding of these practices.
